summary: Office Properties Income Trust filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026 announcing the pricing of $425 million aggregate principal amount of 8.75% Senior Secured Notes due 2031 in a private Rule 144A/Regulation S offering. The issuer intends to use net proceeds to repay all outstanding borrowings under its secured revolving credit facility and secured term loan. Notes and guarantees are unregistered. Closing is subject to customary conditions. No board recommendation, advisor, or equity terms disclosed. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation; watch closing conditions and any leverage or refinancing implications for the credit and equity.
